title: Epikloop cost row
description: One line of ~/.epikloop/projects/<id>/cost.jsonl per turn of a story's worker, holding that turn's share; a worker's lines add up to its run. Written by the emitter, never by the model; the instrument for tuning effort levels.

ts.description: When the turn ended, by the emitter's clock (ISO 8601 UTC).

agent.description: The worker's agent id, the same on each of its lines. Absent on lines written before a line named its worker.

wall.description: Wall-clock seconds, from the emitter's own clock: since the worker's turn before this one ended, or since this turn started when it is the worker's first or that turn died.

cost.description: USD the session's cost rose by over the turn, when a source reports it; null otherwise. Never a placeholder 0.

model.description: Model id when reported; null otherwise.
